Name: I Need Sleep - A Radio Mod
Author: sugarsbt
Description:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/q0p5qAE.png[/img]﻿
This mod adds a radio furniture that you can purchase at Robin's shop or find in the Furniture Catalogue.

﻿[img]https://i.imgur.com/HGyMgea.png[/img]﻿
With the radio, you can listen to various stations just like the TV!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Y7Ux1Hp.png[/img]﻿
So far, there are two color options, gray and pink. But if I have time, I will add more options!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/O0UWm8L.png[/img]﻿

[img]https://i.imgur.com/alNOwjr.png[/img]
Thank you to the people that helped and "forced" me to sleep in the SDV Discord, and especially to Chue (aka[url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/mushymato/mods] Mushymato[/url]﻿ on Nexus)﻿ for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28423]MMAP[/url]﻿ and helping me in the server!
